title: Robot Pool Cleaners That Do the Dirty Work (So You Don't Have To!)
summary: Picture this: it's a blazing hot summer day. You race to the pool, ready to cannonball in, but then you see it—leaves, bugs, and weird green gunk floating on the water. Gross! What if a robot could handle all that yucky stuff for you? Beatbot's pool-cleaning robots are here to save your summer, and they're on sale right now. These aren't your average pool toys. The top model, the Beatbot Sora 50, is like a super-smart underwater vacuum. It has five spinning brushes that scrub the floor, walls, and even the waterline where dirt sticks. Using AI (artificial intelligence, which means it can think and learn), it actually detects debris—like a treasure hunter, but for gunk. It can zoom around for six hours, then float to the surface when the battery gets low. You just scoop it out. There's also a simpler skimmer that glides slowly so it won't crash into walls. It has a big 9-liter basket (that's about the size of a large beach bucket) to hold all the crud. And it charges with solar power or a magnetic pad—no plugging in! The middle robot, the Sora 30, scrubs walls and floors for five hours and comes back on its own. You control them all with an app, like a video game. So, while you're busy perfecting your cannonball, these bots are hard at work. The pool will be so clean, you'll think a magical cleaning fairy visited. But shh, it's just a robot doing the dirty work.
why_it_matters: A clean pool means more time for cannonballs and summer fun, and less time scooping leaves.

background_read: Robotic vacuum cleaners for floors have been around for over 20 years, and now similar robots can clean pools too.
Before robots, pool owners had to manually skim leaves or scrub walls with brushes.
Beatbot, a robotics company, makes these cleaners that use artificial intelligence to make cleaning smarter.
Article_Structure: WHO: Beatbot's robotic pool cleaners, including the Sora 50, Sora 30, and a skimmer.
WHAT: They use spinning brushes, AI detection, and long battery life to scrub floors, walls, and waterlines.
WHY: To let kids and families enjoy a clean pool without doing the dirty work themselves.

perspectives.description: They love that the pool is always ready for play, without having to fish out leaves and bugs.
They might worry about the robot's high price and whether it needs repairs.
They might like the solar-powered option, which reduces electricity use.
